modules.requiredEvents: Founder moderation policy changes and historical restorations with current and requested values, actor, revision, reason and time.
modules.observed: The policy change commits atomically with its history. New native decisions carry the applicable policy revision. A1A exposes persisted account decision revisions above the ambiguous initial default. Historical records retain their original state.
modules.viewers: The recognized Founder reads policy history in an original administration workspace with recent MFA. Eligible enforcement staff receive effective form settings.
modules.excluded: Reporter identities, private evidence, appeal narratives and credentials.
modules.remediation: Maintain the existing private ledger and verify future policy changes against affected writes in disposable environments.

modules.requiredEvents: Independent appeal intake, assignments, reviewer conflicts, findings, dispositions, native restoration and event moderation report linkage.
modules.observed: The appeal event, any ordinary or protected reversal and the member notice commit together. A1A and the Moderation Center project safe references.
modules.viewers: The appellant, assigned independent reviewer, and eligible private administration workspace users have distinct scoped reads.
modules.excluded: Reporter identities, attendee lists, private event data, narratives in general audit and notifications.
modules.remediation: Preserve historical source rows without inferring missing report links. Retention and export policy for private narratives requires a separate review.

modules.requiredEvents: Member onboarding and profile policy revisions
modules.observed: The private ledger stores each policy change with actor, old/new values, reason and server time. The Founder history projects those committed changes.
modules.viewers: Founder with current session, recent MFA and the original workspace
modules.excluded: Private profile values, onboarding form data and provider credentials
modules.remediation: Retain source-controlled policy history and the existing privacy lifecycle.

modules.requiredEvents: Founder changes to public Community Statistics visibility.
modules.observed: The original ledger records the values, actor and reason in the same transaction as the update. The Founder’s audit page reads those records through the original workspace.
modules.viewers: Active Founder, recent MFA and original private workspace only.
modules.excluded: Stats totals, session IDs, request UUIDs and unrelated member details.
modules.remediation: Retain the existing ledger lifecycle and secure Founder projection.

modules.requiredEvents: Founder registration and referral policy revisions, registration invitation issue and consumption, and eligible referral attribution.
modules.observed: Policy changes and invitation state commit in PostgreSQL. Referral attribution retains the existing subject-unique history.
missing: Unified Audit Center read adapter for registration invitation lifecycle
modules.viewers: The active Founder can view registration revisions with recent MFA and the original workspace. Members see only their aggregate count and own stable code.
modules.excluded: Raw credentials, private recipient emails, provider proof, and referred-account identity.
modules.remediation: Add a separately reviewed audit projection under the Audit Center workstream.

modules.requiredEvents: Restriction changes, ordinary platform role grants and revocations, trusted bootstrap
modules.observed: The legacy platform audit reason and subject relations are restricted. Bootstrap is Founder-only in A1A. The public role history uses active S2C platform workspace access.
missing: rejected unauthorized actions as durable events
modules.viewers: Platform Administrator with live S2C link, Founder for bootstrap
modules.excluded: Reasons and unrelated account details

modules.requiredEvents: Founder-direct and legacy proposals, activation, assignment, correction and emergency claim holds
modules.observed: O5 and F1 locked transactions own the records. Founder gets proposal receipt summaries in A1A. Corrections, claim holds, domain authority and private credential lifecycle remain source-scoped.
missing: A1A adapters for O5 correction and authority events
modules.viewers: Founder with live S2C link for A1A proposals
modules.excluded: Credentials, reasons and payload hashes

modules.requiredEvents: Session policy issue, remember, observed expiry, promotion and revocation, workflow creation, closure and completion
modules.observed: S2A policy trigger and S2B commands write native events. A1A self history excludes provider IDs, workflow locators, assurance timestamps and receipt contents.
missing: durable historical access after session deletion
modules.viewers: Current account subject
modules.excluded: Session and workflow references, MFA timestamps

modules.requiredEvents: Application state, assignments, independent decisions, impersonation and appeal resolution, reviewed claim state
modules.observed: Existing submission and review commands enforce actor, assignment and conflicts. A1A reads only ordinary assigned case decisions. Subject/evidence and appeal workflows use existing access.
missing: complete badge and appeal transition inventory for readers
modules.viewers: Assigned unconflicted reviewer for exact case
modules.excluded: Rationale, all evidence and other identities

modules.requiredEvents: Consent, visibility, withdrawal, proof, grant, hold, revocation and supersession; separate Founder registration
modules.observed: The Founder ledgers preserve case, grant and optional application closure references. FV-FINAL adds restricted approval windows, cohort identity and independent appeal decisions. Hosted issuance depends on an approved policy. A standing policy covers eligible members while retaining the same member consent and grant audit records. Account confirmation consumes a session-bound challenge and records the outcome in the existing Founder case ledger. A1A excludes these restricted records.
missing: separately assigned case summary and approved retention
modules.viewers: Subject case summary, recognized Founder using S2C, or assigned and unconflicted independent reviewer in their separate S2C workspace.
modules.excluded: Private proof and credentials

modules.requiredEvents: Handle assignment, change, retirement, reservation, review, hold, release and appeal decision
modules.observed: U1 writes the restricted ledger in Auth triggers and change/review commands. Members see their own assignment and change with allowed handle transitions. Staff-specific reason and lease events remain private.
modules.viewers: Current account subject for eligible U1 events
modules.excluded: Safety reasons, lease and fingerprints

modules.requiredEvents: Current profile, locale, discoverability and avatar reference
modules.observed: Current owner-only settings and public profile projections. Avatar bytes reside in Storage. Revision history is unavailable.
missing: material profile corrections and avatar reconciliation
modules.viewers: Existing subject or public projection
modules.excluded: Private profile fields and media references

modules.requiredEvents: Routine edits and removal state, original post request receipt
modules.observed: Current visibility and versioned feed commands. Ordinary edit history was never recorded and cannot be recovered from current rows.
missing: durable high-impact author removal while evidence is open
modules.viewers: Existing author and permitted viewer
modules.excluded: Post and comment bodies

modules.requiredEvents: Reuse existing publication receipts and scoped moderation records for material content commands. Private preferences and reversible social actions use current state.
modules.observed: Organization and quote posts reuse the original command receipt. Repost and quote notifications are deduplicated in the existing ledger. Source visibility is checked again on read.
modules.viewers: Owner-only saves and preferences. Eligible audiences for attribution and assigned moderators for existing moderation history.
modules.excluded: Bookmarks, private settings, notification recipients, restricted bodies, and member safety decisions from platform-wide reads.
modules.remediation: Retain native content moderation records and keep reversible interactions outside permanent administrative history.

modules.requiredEvents: Reports, hide, restore, remove, dismiss and appeal disposition
modules.observed: Feed and scoped moderation commands write actions atomically. A1A uses general feed actions only. Community-linked history, issue reports and appeals remain domain-bound.
modules.viewers: Live platform leadership or designated general feed moderator
modules.excluded: Body, reports, raw reasons and room metadata

modules.requiredEvents: Platform restrictions and ordinary block or mute preferences
modules.observed: Administrative restrictions have a platform event. Member block and mute use current feed safety state and existing controls. A1A avoids publishing interaction or blocked account history.
modules.viewers: Subject for safety settings, platform admin for restrictions
modules.excluded: Relationships and rationale

modules.requiredEvents: Intent selection, consent, setup, cancellation, claim, registration and protected corrections
modules.observed: O2 commands store versioned owner receipts. O4 commits successful setup, ownership and declarations with institutional events. O5 separately records privileged corrections. None of these receipts are exposed in A1A.
modules.viewers: Current owner and independently assigned staff
modules.excluded: Drafts and raw receipts

modules.requiredEvents: Ownership, representatives, staff, invitations, affiliations and restrictions
modules.observed: O4, Phase 2D and affiliation workflow retain policy-specific provenance. Owner or scoped assignment checks differ across commands. No A1A adapter for these ledgers.
missing: normalized representative and affiliation read receipts
modules.viewers: Existing organization-specific authority
modules.excluded: Contacts and invitation recipients

modules.requiredEvents: Custom role configuration, assignments, revocation and relationship retirement
modules.observed: Current foundation owner or organization administrator can view one tenant; native Phase 5D writes the ledger within role transactions. A1A omits the JSON states and identities of other members.
modules.viewers: Current organization owner or foundation administrator
modules.excluded: Raw before and after documents and other member identities

modules.requiredEvents: Group creation and ownership, staff role changes, admissions, removals and moderation
modules.observed: Group and department commands own these records. Active resource-specific group or department assignments remain the access boundary. A1A excludes both adapters and community-linked feed actions.
missing: complete removal and staff decision history
modules.viewers: Current assigned room staff
modules.excluded: Private room metadata and roster

modules.requiredEvents: Proposals, independent reviews, decisions, roles, volunteering, tasks, milestones, evidence and outcomes
modules.observed: Project proposal, operations and progress commands preserve their own state and events. Submission and publication validate the existing project restriction in the same transaction as the native event. Account, project and institutional grant rules determine access. No cross-project adapter in A1A.
missing: audit full progress and final-report redaction and role matrix
modules.viewers: Existing current project, organization or independent reviewer
modules.excluded: Progress evidence and private contact

modules.requiredEvents: Creation, eligible configuration, nomination decisions, suspension, finalization and disposition
modules.observed: Versioned poll commands own the event trail. Ballots remain an independent restricted store with sole permitted voter access. A1A has no ballot join or poll adapter.
modules.viewers: Existing secured poll role
modules.excluded: Individual ballots and electorate identity

modules.requiredEvents: Nomination, offer, consent, access, feedback, suspension and termination
modules.observed: O6 transactions use fixture-approved participation and separate operator assignments. Actual enrollment remains disabled. No A1A adapter.
missing: operational approval and explicit visibility policy
modules.viewers: Separately scoped synthetic operator or subject
modules.excluded: Private feedback and cohort records

modules.requiredEvents: Availability, version approval and emergency suspension
modules.observed: L6.2A applies its own proof registry and authorization. Broader audit access has no legal publication authority. Publication and acceptance stay off.
missing: staff-safe release projection after approver policy
modules.viewers: Existing authorized legal role
modules.excluded: Approval package and unpublished content

modules.requiredEvents: Rights intake, scoped review, export generation, evidence holds, lifecycle and synthetic recovery
modules.observed: Dedicated synthetic-only intake, export and lifecycle workflows retain their own evidence and receipt rules. Real processing remains disabled. No A1A adapter.
missing: approved evidence and metadata retention, designated operators, rights processing authorization
modules.viewers: Existing synthetic subject and scoped privacy operator
modules.excluded: Export bytes, rights cases, raw reasons and evidence

modules.requiredEvents: Invitation, consent, status and visibility decisions
modules.observed: Program-specific and backend-scoped outcome ledger. A1A omits this source pending a scoped public-consent and staff audit review.
missing: independent nomination and consent read reconciliation
modules.viewers: Current approved program authorities and subject
modules.excluded: Private evidence and invite details

modules.requiredEvents: Cross-module durable security denials and export-proof operational receipts
modules.observed: Fastify logs route/status and request correlation. These diagnostics do not constitute actor-linked event evidence.
modules.viewers: Operational access under separate policy
modules.excluded: Query payloads, tokens and personal data

modules.requiredEvents: Enrollment, benefit decisions, protected referrals and external financial effects
modules.observed: Current development has no authorized processing. Future module reports must document event source, actor, transaction and data handling before implementation.
modules.viewers: Pending policy
modules.excluded: Beneficiary, medical and financial information

modules.requiredEvents: Record grant changes, workspace opening, consent, exact revision inspection, assignments, decisions, challenges, withdrawal and invalidation.
modules.observed: Actor-bound receipts retain the assignment scope, revision, disclosure fingerprint and reasoning; automatic invalidation records the affected revision and time.
modules.viewers: The current organizer and scoped coordinator can read permitted case history. Assigned reviewers can read only the current authorized review packet.
modules.excluded: No audit metadata, identities or private reasons enter the public result projection.
modules.remediation: Investigate suppressed disclosures from the scoped private ledger and use a newly consented, independently approved revision after the source is valid.

modules.requiredEvents: Record configuration, grant, catalog, mapping, consent, report and suppression decisions.
modules.observed: Protected changes retain the current actor, workspace, request fingerprint, reason, before and after state, and version. Automatic suppression records the affected release privately.
modules.viewers: The Founder can inspect redacted settings history, and qualified independent reviewers and members receive scoped records.
modules.excluded: Public reports omit private cases, identities, receipts, source evidence and consent details.
modules.remediation: Inspect the original private receipt or protected lifecycle dependency. Independently review a disjoint eligible report when a new release is needed.
